name: inpatient_encounter_primary_reason
title: Inpatient Encounter Primary Reason
description: Encounter diagnoses of inpatient (IMP) encounters only, i.e. the diagnoses of hospitalizations. Same features as encounter_primary_reason, which covers encounters of every class (emergency, ambulatory, etc.). Use this one for hospitalization features and outcomes.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: primaryReasonCodes
feature.title: Condition codes (ICD-10)
feature.description: ICD-10 codes for the conditions which are the main reasons of the inpatient encounter.

feature.name: encounterRef
feature.title: Encounter reference
feature.description: Reference to the inpatient encounter the condition was diagnosed in (Condition.encounter). A feature rather than the encounterId entity, because in a feature set join the population's encounterId (the index encounter) takes the place of the feature group's own encounterId column. Used to count distinct hospitalizations instead of diagnoses.
